name: Revdoku
description: Create and manage email inboxes for AI agents, with cloud storage for emails, attachments, and files.

signup.requires: Human owner authorization and private email verification; creates the account, first inbox, and API key.

capabilities: Create and manage email inboxes for AI agents
Receive email and attachments at each bucket's incoming address
List messages with polling cursors, read decoded email, and download originals and attachments with email tools
Store documents, data, and source files in private cloud buckets
Share bucket files with authorized people and AI connections
Read, write, and append shared files; coordinate edits with locks and revision checks
Inspect versions and change history; restore earlier files
Sign up through REST or MCP with human authorization and private email verification, or use browser signup
